rationale.oversight-explanation: Decision Bank and traceable tests improved developers’ understanding of generated implementations.
rationale.automation-bias: Baseline agent users passively approved plans and later misunderstood generated code.
rationale.ai-review: A separate AI planner translated human decisions into artifact-checking test oracles.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Executable test suites deterministically checked implementations against recorded decisions.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Per-decision tests detect implementation departures from the programmer’s recorded intent.
